in_hebrew.name: Prinz
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Prinz הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the German word 'prinz' meaning 'prince'. Historically, princes were the sons of kings and heirs to the throne. In Christian contexts, the term can also symbolize spiritual royalty and the divine nature of every human being.
